newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: ABN AMRO already biggest foreign bank in N America.
newsitem.headline: ABN AMRO already biggest foreign bank in N America.

text.p: ABN AMRO Holding NV, which announced the planned purchase of Standard Federal Bancorporation Inc. on Friday, gave the following details of its existing operations in the United States:
* Biggest foreign bank in North America with total assets of $68 billion and 11,000 employees.
* One of the few banks allowed to conduct both commercial and investment banking activities in the U.S. after winning Section 20 licence from Federal Reserve Board in December 1994.
* Licence entitles bank to underwrite and trade both bond and equity issues.
* String of acquisitions in state of Illinois began with LaSalle National Corp (1979).
* Others included Lane Financial (1987), Exchange Bancorp (1990), Talman (1992) Cragin (1994), Comerica Illinois (1996) Columbia National Bank (1996).
* Subsequent Illinois acquisitions were consolidated within LaSalle which mainly operates in Chicago area where it has 130 branches and 7,750 staff.
* LaSalle is the biggest savings bank in Illinois and second largest bank in Chicago.
* In state of New York ABN AMRO owns European American Bank with 87 branches, 1,775 staff and total assets of $9.2 billion.
* ABN AMRO also operates branches in 10 major U.S. cities under its own name which service major corporations. They employ 1,270 staff and have combined assets of $14.3 billion.
* ABN AMRO announced acquisition of Chicago Corporation earlier this year but is still awaiting approval from supervisory authorities.
